verdict.rationale: Codex docs directly state you can configure the dependencies, tools, variables, and setup steps each repository needs. Tasks run in isolated cloud environments, and the CLI can submit work to a configured environment, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is only marketing-level one-liners, though. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the environment configuration mechanism (base image, setup script format, caching), explicit evidence of reproducibility guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
